public static class LoweredKinds
{
    public static readonly int Digits = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LDigits);
    public static readonly int Number = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LNumber);
    public static readonly int Word = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LWord);
    public static readonly int Name = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LName);
    public static readonly int File = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LFile);
    public static readonly int Input = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LInput);
    public static readonly int Fixed = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LFixed);
    public static readonly int Plain = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LPlain);
    public static readonly int Statement = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LStatement);
    public static readonly int Add = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LAdd);
    public static readonly int Turn = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LTurn);
    public static readonly int Wrap = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LWrap);
    public static readonly int Num = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LNum);
    public static readonly int Ref = LoweredModule.Kind(LoweredModule.LRef);
}

public readonly struct FileNode : ISyntaxView<FileNode>
{
    public FileNode(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public SyntaxList<SyntaxNode> Items => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 0));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => tree.Kind(index) == LoweredKinds.File;

    public static FileNode Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public readonly struct InputNode : ISyntaxView<InputNode>
{
    public InputNode(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public Token Name => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 1));

    public Token Annotation => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 3));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => tree.Kind(index) == LoweredKinds.Input;

    public static InputNode Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public readonly struct RefNode : ISyntaxView<RefNode>
{
    public RefNode(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public Token Name => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 0));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => tree.Kind(index) == LoweredKinds.Ref;

    public static RefNode Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public abstract class LoweredVisitor<TResult>
{
    public virtual TResult Visit(SyntaxTree tree, int node)
    {
        int kind = tree.Kind(node);
        if (SyntaxKinds.ModuleOf(kind) == LoweredModule.Instance.Id)
        {
            switch (SyntaxKinds.LocalOf(kind))
            {
                case LoweredModule.LFile: return VisitFile(new FileNode(tree, node));
                case LoweredModule.LInput: return VisitInput(new InputNode(tree, node));
                case LoweredModule.LFixed: return VisitFixed(new FixedNode(tree, node));
                case LoweredModule.LPlain: return VisitPlain(new PlainNode(tree, node));
                case LoweredModule.LStatement: return VisitStatement(new StatementNode(tree, node));
                case LoweredModule.LAdd: return VisitAdd(new AddNode(tree, node));
                case LoweredModule.LTurn: return VisitTurn(new TurnNode(tree, node));
                case LoweredModule.LWrap: return VisitWrap(new WrapNode(tree, node));
                case LoweredModule.LNum: return VisitNum(new NumNode(tree, node));
                case LoweredModule.LRef: return VisitRef(new RefNode(tree, node));
            }
        }
        return DefaultVisit(tree, node);
    }

    public TResult Visit<TView>(TView view) where TView : struct, ISyntaxView<TView> => Visit(view.Tree, view.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitFile(FileNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitInput(InputNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitFixed(FixedNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitPlain(PlainNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitStatement(StatementNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitAdd(AddNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitTurn(TurnNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitWrap(WrapNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitNum(NumNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitRef(RefNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    protected virtual TResult DefaultVisit(SyntaxTree tree, int node) => default!;
}
